Thought: The mass spectrometry data provides the m/z values and their respective intensities. The most intense peak, often called the base peak, is at m/z 114.0681. This is likely the molecular ion peak, which represents the molecular weight of the compound. I will use this information to deduce the molecular formula.

The m/z value of 114.0681 suggests a molecular weight of approximately 114.07. Common elements in organic compounds are carbon (C), hydrogen (H), and oxygen (O). I will consider possible combinations of these elements that sum to this molecular weight.

A plausible combination is C6H10O2, which has a molecular weight of approximately 114.07 (C: 12.01, H: 1.01, O: 16.00).
